test_cases.title: Registered user receives time-limited reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user receives a time-limited reset link via email.

steps.action: A registered user enters their email address in the password reset form and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system generates a time-limited reset link and sends it to the registered email address via email, with a clear message indicating the link is valid for a specific time period (e.g., 15 minutes).

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Unregistered user receives same confirmation message as registered user
test_cases.objective: Verify that an unregistered user receives the same confirmation message as a registered user when attempting to reset a password.

steps.action: An unregistered user enters an email address in the password reset form and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system displays the same confirmation message as for registered users (e.g., 'A reset link has been sent to your email. It will expire in 15 minutes.') regardless of whether the email is registered or not.

source_requirements: The same confirmation is shown for registered and unregistered emails.

test_cases.title: New password satisfies password policy
test_cases.objective: Verify that the new password meets the defined password policy when resetting a password.

steps.action: A user clicks on the reset link, enters a new password that satisfies the password policy (e.g., at least 8 characters, one uppercase, one number), and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts the password and updates the user's account with the new password, confirming successful reset.

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the password policy.

test_cases.title: Invalid email input results in error message and no reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that invalid input (e.g., empty email or invalid format) results in an error message and does not proceed to generate a reset link.

steps.action: A user submits the password reset form with an empty email field.
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message (e.g., 'Email is required') and does not generate or send a reset link.

steps.action: A user submits the form with an email that does not follow valid format (e.g., 'invalid-email').
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message (e.g., 'Invalid email format') and does not generate or send a reset link.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Reset link expires after time-limited period
test_cases.objective: Verify that the reset link expires after the time-limited period, and attempting to use it after expiration fails.

steps.action: A registered user receives a reset link that is valid for 15 minutes.
steps.expected_result: The system generates a reset link valid for 15 minutes from issuance.

steps.action: The user attempts to use the reset link 16 minutes after it was issued.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the link and displays a message such as 'The reset link has expired.'

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Password policy violation is rejected
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system handles a user attempting to reset a password with a password that does not meet the policy (e.g., less than 8 characters).

steps.action: A user clicks on the reset link and enters a new password that does not satisfy the policy (e.g., '1234567').
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the password and displays a message such as 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.'

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the password policy.
